objectives: We performed this quantitative synthesis to consolidate the latest evidence comparing the surgical efficacy and safety profile of the MAKO platform against manual UKA procedures. The aims were to evaluate pain outcomes (VAS, PCS), functional outcomes (AKSS, AKSS Total, AKSSF, OKS, FJS), radiological implant positioning/alignment accuracy (MFTA, FCCA, TCCA, TCPT, LFCFEA, FCCA outliers, TCCA outliers), and perioperative metrics (operative time, ROM, complication rate, PJI rate, revision rate) for MAKO-UKA versus conventional UKA.
inclusion_criteria: Studies qualified for inclusion if they used a comparative design (such as RCTs or observational cohorts) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis treated with either robotic or manual UKA, assessed at least one clinical or radiographic parameter (VAS, PCS, AKSS, AKSS Total, AKSSF, OKS, FJS, MFTA, FCCA, TCCA, TCPT, LFCFEA, FCCA outlier, TCCA outlier, operation time, ROM, complication rate, PJI rate, revision rate), and provided enough raw data to derive effect sizes (RR, OR, or MD).
exclusion_criteria: Excluded were non-primary research articles such as narrative reviews, editorials, and case series, conference abstracts, and publications lacking extractable quantitative results; during full-text review, 5 articles were excluded for insufficient or inconsistent outcome data.
pmid_query: ((Unicompartmental Knee Arthroplasty) OR (Arthroplasty, Replacement, Partial Knee) OR (Arthroplasty, Unicompartmental Knee) OR (Knee Arthroplasty, Unicompartmental) OR (Unicompartmental Knee Replacement) OR (Knee Replacement, Unicompartmental) OR (Partial Knee Replacement) OR (Knee Replacement, Partial) OR (Unicondylar Knee Replacement) OR (Knee Replacement, Unicondylar) OR (Unicondylar Knee Arthroplasty) OR (Arthroplasty, Unicondylar Knee) OR (Knee Arthroplasty, Unicondylar) OR (Partial Knee Arthroplasty) OR (Arthroplasty, Partial Knee) OR (Knee Arthroplasty, Partial)) AND (MAKO)
selection_evidence: Results/PRISMA report that 22 studies [17-38] met the inclusion criteria after 678 records were identified, 164 duplicates were removed, 487 records were excluded at title/abstract screening, and 5 full texts were excluded for insufficient or inconsistent outcome data. Table 2 lists 22 included author-year entries, and Table 3 re-lists the same study set by outcome contribution. The Table 2 roster matches references 17-38 one-for-one: Banger 2021, Bell 2016, Blyth 2017, Cabuk 2022, Clement 2023, Cool 2019, FuJun 2017, Gilmour 2018, MacCallum/Katherine 2016, Hansen 2014, Kayani 2018, Kayani 2019, Lonner 2010, Maritan 2023, Motesharei 2018, Park 2019, St Mart 2020, Tan 2025, Thilak 2020, Wong 2019, Wu 2021, and Yin 2021.
notes:

Table 2 label "Katherine 2016" corresponds to reference 25 (MacCallum KP et al., 2016). All selected references 17-38 are literature studies rather than websites, datasets, or software repositories.
